name: dsh-long-term-memory
description: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-memory-file): injects your own Markdown memory files each session, adds read/write/recall tools with backup and undo, guides the agent to read detailed memory files (interests / profile / project notes), reports DSH_HOME drift, and (opt-in) surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Reads no conversations by default; never opens a network connection.
